notes.title: Cube0S is out!
notes.content:
A turn-based puzzle is available! I wish all fans of the genre a good game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2583460/CubeOS/

CubeOS is a logic turn-based puzzle game, you play as a High-Tech Cube, the goal of whom is to complete the level at all costs. The motivation for the hero will be added later! (UPD: Motivation has been added!)

[list][*]Over 90 levels
[*]A variety of enemies
[*]10 types of interactive items
[*]Challenges along the way
[*]Portals
[*]Simple levels
[*]Terribly difficult levels
[*]Plot
[*]Cute Sci-fi style
[*]Steam Achievements
[*]Steam Cloud[/list]

notes.title: Zup! Arena Now available!
notes.content:
Zup bro! "Zup! Arena" Now available!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/914160/Zup_Arena/
Zup! Arena is a multiplayer arcade game in which you have to fight with other players! Throw off all your opponents from the battlefield and become the "King of the mountain". Play alone or in a group with friends!

Earn Zup-bucks for winning and participating in battles and use customization to make your character unique and the cutest! Fight on one of 6 unique arenas! 

Level up to get additional rewards and unique decorations of the game profile!

- Fight alone among 8 players or play in a group
- A unique battlefield
- Customization items
- Support for most controllers
- Steam Achievements

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25807341/e0869550fa1f6d0cecc96f3722b96a9594e0f312.png[/img]

tags.feature: - Added three new playable heroes: Queen of Pain, Slark, and Templar Assassin
